description: A Bot's browser tool's request (baudelib.emissiontools) to the Emission that has the Bot's own profile here, started for it if none has (or to the phone showing it).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

default.description: The call is to Emission's own window here on its Default profile instead of a Bot's (☰ → Browser from another host, watched): what a Browser pane does (tabs, navigate, new_tab, close_tab, select_tab, click, hover, drag, type, key, scroll, answer_prompt, copy, paste), nothing else.
